**Date:** 2026-05-20
**Tag:** `v4.3.0`
**Base:** `v4.2.1`
**Range since rc.1:** `v4.3.0-rc.1..v4.3.0` — four follow-up fixes

---

## Summary

`v4.3.0` promotes [`v4.3.0-rc.1`](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/releases/tag/v4.3.0-rc.1) to stable after one rc cycle. The release is dominated by **PXE / wallet-side improvements**, a **new opt-in SQLite kv-store backend**, and **Aztec.nr / TXE ergonomics**. See the [`v4.3.0-rc.1` release notes](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/releases/tag/v4.3.0-rc.1) for the full breaking-change list and detailed highlights, and [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/blob/v4.3.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the complete categorized commit list.

Only **four small fixes** landed between `rc.1` and stable — all around macOS install ergonomics and release-image metadata.

---

## What contract developers should care about

- **Two breaking changes** carried over from rc.1:
  - `aztec init` / `aztec new` now scaffold a *counter* template — any tooling or docs relying on the prior default contents must update ([#22751](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22751)).
  - `aztec-nr`'s history module now consumes shared protocol-circuit utilities — direct consumers of internal history-module helpers must adapt.
  - Migration steps live under `## 4.3.0-rc.1` in [`docs/docs-developers/docs/resources/migration_notes.md`](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/blob/v4.3.0/docs/docs-developers/docs/resources/migration_notes.md).
- **Aztec.nr / TXE ergonomics**:
  - Initial handshake registry contract with non-interactive handshake function ([#22854](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22854)).
  - `call_self` stubs for utility functions ([#22885](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22885)).
  - Contract function return types and parameters are now asserted serializable at compile time ([#22877](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22877)).
  - TXE gains **oracle versioning** and basic gas settings, mirroring production behavior more closely ([#23285](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23285), [#23289](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23289)).
- **Cross-contract utility calls**: end-to-end support for nested utility calls in PXE and TXE, with authorization hooks ([#23007](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23007), [#23064](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23064), [#22822](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22822)).
- **CLI**: 2-crate scaffolds, contract version stamping in artifacts, `aztec profile gates --json`, `aztec-nr`-dependency version assertion ([#21007](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21007), [#22550](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22550), [#22860](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22860), [#21245](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/21245)).

## What node operators should care about

This release is wallet/dev-side-heavy. Notable for ops:

- **Sequencer signs the last block before archiver sync** ([#22117](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22117)) — correctness/ordering improvement around block signing.
- **Release image now stamps `stdlib/package.json` with the release version** ([#23393](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23393)) — fixes a published-artifact metadata mismatch that affected downstream consumers of the stdlib package.
- Several smaller `aztec-up` install-path fixes; if you bootstrap nodes via `aztec-up`, macOS install ergonomics are improved (see "What changed since rc.1" below).

## What wallet / PXE users should care about

- **New opt-in SQLite kv-store backend** ([#22658](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22658), [#22759](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22759), [#23089](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23089), [#23231](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23231)): SQLite-on-WASM-over-OPFS implementation of the PXE / wallet kv-store, alongside existing LMDB and IndexedDB backends. A page-level-encrypted variant is available for stricter browser environments. **Opt-in at wallet construction time**; existing stores continue to work unchanged.
- **Materially faster PXE sync** — batched nullifier sync across scopes, batched log RPC calls, prefetched class-id hints, short-circuited block-header lookups at the anchor block, parallel per-scope contract syncs ([#23129](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23129), [#23131](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23131), [#23123](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23123), [#23130](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23130), [#23100](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23100), [#23088](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23088), [#22525](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22525)).
- **PXE correctness fixes worth knowing**:
  - Dropped tagging indices no longer crash PXE on sync ([#23044](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23044)).
  - Anchor-header threading in PXE simulation paths (backport of [#22679](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22679)).
  - Origin/contract address mismatch now throws instead of silently producing wrong simulation results ([#22637](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22637)).
  - Race conditions in block-stream event handling serialized away ([#22635](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22635)).
  - `setSenderForTags` scope correctness restricted to the current call (F-564, [#22672](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22672)).
- **`wallet-sdk` heartbeat** for liveness signalling ([#22948](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/22948)).

---

## What changed since `v4.3.0-rc.1`

Four follow-up fixes — all small:

- **`add_crate.sh` portability on macOS** ([#23335](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23335)): use `perl -i` instead of GNU-specific `sed -i`.
- **`aztec-up` macOS install** ([#23310](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23310)): fall back to no-timeout when `/usr/bin/timeout` is absent.
- **Release image metadata** ([#23393](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23393)): stamp `stdlib/package.json` with the release version.
- **CI** ([#23318](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/pull/23318)): reduce backwards-compat e2e timeout.

---

## Reference

- [`v4.3.0-rc.1` release notes](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/releases/tag/v4.3.0-rc.1) — full breaking-change list, detailed highlights, notable bug fixes
- [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/blob/v4.3.0/CHANGELOG.md) — complete categorized commit list
- [Migration notes](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/aztec-packages/blob/v4.3.0/docs/docs-developers/docs/resources/migration_notes.md) — under `## 4.3.0-rc.1`
